name: yesboss-backend
description: YesBoss workforce management platform — backend monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:auth" "pnpm run dev:workforce" "pnpm run dev:communication" "pnpm run dev:gateway" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:logs: echo 'Logs are now aggregated in the single terminal'
scripts.build: pnpm run --filter @yesboss/types build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/errors build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/utils build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/auth build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/workforce build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/communication build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/dev-gateway build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm run --filter @yesboss/types build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/errors build && pnpm run --filter @yesboss/utils build
